label: FACIS DSP — IAM Issuance
info:
NF-1 follow-on: this connector's own did:web identity, Participant
VC self-issuance, and a minimal OID4VCI issuer surface.

GET /.well-known/did.json                  — this connector's did:web document
GET /.well-known/openid-credential-issuer  — static OID4VCI issuer metadata
POST /iam/oid4vci/credential               — issues a fresh self-signed
                                              Participant VC (jwt_vc_json),
                                              Bearer-guarded

Adapted from the Partner Onboarding (Reference FAP)'s
"4-create did,chain files.json" (did:web + JWK build — note the two-entry
@context array, formally required for JsonWebKey2020), "8-create VCs.json"
(JOSE VC signing + GXDCH notary/compliance calls), and "9-create VP.json"
(GXDCH compliance hand-off). The private key is NEVER generated on the pod:
it is read from env.get('DSP_CONNECTOR_KEY'), pre-provisioned via the
keySecret Secret (Task 8's Helm work). Issued VCs are pushed onto
global.get('identityHubPending') — an in-memory handoff queue Task 13's
hub tab drains and persists to Mongo; this tab only issues.

See orce/tests/flows/iam-issuance-did.spec.js for the mirrored pure logic
dsp-iam-issuance-did-fn's DID-document builder must stay consistent with.

name: build + serve did.json
build OID4VCI issuer metadata
Bearer presence guard
build + sign Participant VC
notary result → call compliance?
push to identityHubPending
